description: Erection of a three storey side extension to the house
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (7267/ 1, 7267/ 2, 7267/ 3, 7267/ 4, 7267/ 5, 7267/ 6, 7267/ 7, 7267/ LP, Design and Access Statement October 2019. Received: 11/10/2019. 7267 09 Rev. A, 7267 10 Rev. A, 7267 11 Rev. A, 7267 12 Rev. A, 7267 13 Rev. A, 7267 14 Rev. A, 7267 15 Rev. A, 7267 16 Rev. A, 7267 17 Rev. A. Received: 22/11/2019) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the flank walls of the extension hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - The extension hereby permitted shall not be occupied or brought into use until the means of vehicular access has been constructed.

Condition : 6 - The extension hereby approved shall be used solely as part of the house known as 42 Burlington Road, Chiswick, W4 4BE and shall not be occupied as a separate dwelling nor used for business purposes and the premises shall not be used as a house in multiple occupation, including any use within Class C4 of The Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987 (as amended) or such other legislation as may subsequently supersede it.
